TL;DW Executive Summary:
This video debunks the "day trading" scam by using rigorous math to expose the impossibility of the inflated returns often advertised in trading thumbnails
I highlighted that if these extreme P&L claims were consistent, they would imply a Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) that would mathematically lead to more wealth than exists in the entire world, exposing them as cherry-picked or fraudulent
I demonstrated that markets are not fair games but environments where the "house"—those who understand position sizing and risk management—consistently wins against uninformed players who are destined to blow out their accounts
By analyzing the lack of counterfactuals and the non-convergence of probability distributions in real-world market regimes, we explained why backtested indicators frequently fail when applied out-of-sample
Ultimately, we advocated for a focus on long-term positioning and survival, showing through comparative simulations that hedged, active management portfolios often outperform unhedged market exposure by mitigating drawdowns and harnessing the power of geometric convexity

I hope you enjoyed, and I hope you learned something!

Roman
